title: MoveObjectResult
description: The structured outcome of a move_object execution. Machine-readable by design: a caller decides what happened from `applied`, `already_applied`, `verified` and `error`, never from prose. The conditionals below make the invariants unfakeable: a failure can never claim to have applied or verified anything, a success is never reported without verification, and applied/already_applied are mutually exclusive.

resolved_object.description: What the reference actually resolved to in the scene.

previous_position_meters.description: World-space position read before any mutation. Absent if the object could not be read.

final_position_meters.description: World-space position read back after the operation. Absent if the object could not be read.

applied.description: True only when this execution performed the mutation.

already_applied.description: True when the scene was already at desired_after_meters, so nothing was moved. This is the retry-safe success path.

verified.description: True only when the position was read back and matches desired_after_meters within the documented tolerance.

allOf.description: A failure must not claim to have applied or verified anything.
A mutation is never reported as applied unless it was verified.
applied and already_applied are mutually exclusive.
The already-applied path is a verified success with a known position.
